summary: User story 'Bilder extraheras inte och läggs separat' is fully fixed. BACKEND: 7/7 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_figures_and_zip.py (1 OCR + 1 /process = 2 paid AI calls). (1) Built a Swedish A4 PDF with inserted photo-like noise/gradient JPEG via pymupdf insert_image, uploaded via chunked /uploads, waited for Gemini fast OCR -> status=done, >=1 figure returned with https CommHub url + file_id (verified n/id/box_2d). This proves pipeline.process_page's new 2-pass logic (reading pass + detect_figures fallback) locates product-image/photo content. (2) /api/documents/{id}/export?format=zip returned a ZIP that contains bilder/sida_01_bild_01.jpg (valid JPEG, >500 bytes) AND bilder/bildtexter.txt whose line matches the filename and includes the caption 'Sida 1: ...'. (3) PATCH /api/pages/{id} with the [[FIGURE:n]] placeholder removed from markdown -> ZIP STILL contains bilder/*.jpg, proving build_files/figure_labels iterates figures list (not markdown refs) for the ZIP. (4) PATCH /api/pages/{id}/figures/{fig_id} {deleted:true} -> ZIP image count drops to 0 (one-page doc). Restoring (deleted:false) brings it back. (5) POST /api/process with instruction 'Sammanfatta ...' returned a generated doc; after polling it reached status=ready with non-empty markdown AND source_figures containing >=1 image id. Downloading its /export?format=zip returned a ZIP containing bilder/bild_01.jpg + bildtexter.txt — verifying the backend fix that generated docs now carry source_figures/figure_captions and build_files packs ALL of them into the ZIP, not only the ones referenced inline. (6) Global settings pre- and post-test were speed_mode=fast + primary_provider=gemini (both OpenAI and Gemini keys configured; anthropic has no key). FRONTEND (web, 1366x860 and 390x844): seeded a scan doc with 2 figures in mongo, loaded /doc/{id} with pre-set JSON-encoded localStorage token. Toolbar renders 'Bilder (2)' (testID figures-open). Clicking it opens FiguresPanel (testID figures-panel) listing both items (testID figure-item) with page label 'Sida 1' + their captions. Clicking 'Förhandsgranska' (testID figure-preview) opens the full-size preview (testID figure-preview-modal) with the caption line and 'Tryck för att stänga' hint; tapping backdrop closes it (verified count==0). Toggling the first figure with figure-item-toggle updates the panel header to 'Bilder (1)' AND after closing the panel the toolbar label updates to 'Bilder (1)'. Restoring brings it back to (2). All of this also works on 390x844 mobile viewport. No red-screen error, no uncaught TypeError in console. Settings remain speed_mode=fast + primary_provider=gemini.
critical_code_review_comments: pipeline.process_page's fallback detect_figures() correctly runs ONLY when the reading pass returned 0 figures. For real pages that already have figures from the reading pass (e.g. textbook diagrams), this avoids a second paid AI call. Good.
detect_figures() always uses Gemini when available, which is cheapest/fastest for spatial box_2d — correct choice. Falls back to pick_primary(settings, keys) when gemini has no key.

export.build_files builds the ZIP figures from `allfigs = {**figmap, **source_figures}` and feeds the labels dict (figure_labels) with EVERY non-deleted figure for scan docs — this is why removing [[FIGURE:n]] from markdown no longer deletes the image from the ZIP (verified in test_04).

figure_labels() for generated docs iterates `source_figures or figures` so a generated doc produced BEFORE the fix (no source_figures) will still export images from the inline `figures` dict — nice backward compatibility.

FiguresPanel.collectFigures() dedupes nothing when `source_figures` and `figures` contain the same id — intentional via spread order (figures overrides source_figures). No real duplicate render observed.
FiguresPanel toggle sends PATCH /pages/{id}/figures/{figId} with {deleted: !it.deleted}; onPageChanged(resp) updates the parent doc so the toolbar count re-renders — verified live.
The 'Bilder (n)' label uses collectFigures(doc).filter((f) => !f.deleted).length which runs on EVERY render of the doc screen (cheap but could be memoized). Not a bug.
FiguresPanel preview Modal uses transparent + fade on top of the pageSheet Modal — on react-native-web this nests two Modals; works correctly in both desktop and mobile preview, no z-index issue.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of 'Bilder extraheras inte och läggs separat': three gaps now closed. (A) OCR prompt treated product photos/logos/emblems as decorative — ai.OCR_PROMPT now explicitly includes 'product images and logos/emblems' in the figure criteria. (B) When the reading pass returned zero figures (common for real phone photos of packaging where the whole frame is 'the product'), nothing cropped the image — pipeline.process_page now runs a dedicated Gemini-fast detect_figures() pass with FIGURE_PROMPT whenever res['figures'] is empty, appends [[FIGURE:n]] placeholders to the markdown and crops/uploads each box to CommHub. (C) ZIP export only included images referenced by the final markdown — export.build_files + figure_labels now enumerate EVERY non-deleted figure of every done page (sida_NN_bild_MM.jpg) plus bildtexter.txt with per-image caption line; generated docs persist source_figures + figure_captions so their ZIPs include the source images even if the AI output never references them. All three closures verified end-to-end with real AI + real export above.
